prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent RGBA atlas 1536x1024 for a hand-crafted paper pop-up battle stage. Twelve isolated asset cutouts, exact 4 columns by 3 rows, clean transparent gutters at least 24 px. No grid lines or text. Every part entirely inside its cell.
STYLE PRIORITY: visibly thin colored paper sheets, illustration like an elaborate paper theatre, overlapping flat silhouettes with fine cream cut edges, graphic hatching and small pasted paper facets. Rich detailed craftsmanship but fundamentally 2D cutout art, not realistic stone, not a 3D miniature, not chunky blocks. Frontal camera, barely any top-down perspective. Soft narrow shadows only between paper laminations. No fuzzy ambient background, no glow clouds, no shadows on an invisible ground. Empty pixels must be truly transparent. No characters, ball, UI, logos, labels or watermarks.
Theme: Pokémon Emerald Marine Cave, an ancient blue ocean cavern. Deep indigo, azure, turquoise, desaturated sea green, pale ivory salt. Detailed torn paper fibres and engraved contour lines, a little sparse seaweed and barnacles.
Row 1 left to right:
1. Tall left cliff SILHOUETTE of overlapping vertical indigo paper strips with irregular pale cut edges, not a chunky cliff model.
2. Different tall right cliff SILHOUETTE, stepped blue paper mineral bands and two small pale seams.
3. Distant cave ridge of many overlapping slim deep-blue paper spires, irregular top, broad low bottom, airy gaps at tips, no filled square background.
4. Hanging fringe of seven thin uneven blue-and-ivory stalactite paper triangles joined by a narrow irregular top strip, not a thick rock slab.
Row 2:
5. Narrow vertical waterfall ribbon, several parallel turquoise paper strips with small ivory highlights and foam scallops at bottom; no rocks.
6. Broad shallow ring of paper ripples viewed slightly from above, overlapping indigo and turquoise scalloped concentric wave ribbons; darker blue paper inside, no hole and no surrounding cliffs or rocks.
7. Broad low horizontal surf ribbon of alternating turquoise/azure paper layers, individual ivory foam scallops, no rocks.
8. Low dry slate shelf silhouette with a pale flat top, layered indigo paper fascia and a few white barnacles, no water.
Row 3:
9. Modest fan of layered seaweed, thin olive/teal blades with cut veins and three small shell shapes at the base.
10. Small scattered pale shells and flat blue pebble chips, irregular loose grouping, no ground plane.
11. Small asymmetrical jagged blue rock outcrop made from six separate overlapping FLAT paper facets, pale cut edges, no water or plants.
12. Three separated paper bubble rings of different sizes, pale aqua/ivory, transparent centers, arranged vertically and well apart for individual cropping.
Separate detailed components only, no complete scene. All twelve must look like thin paper flats when brought upright in the game.
